These files were generated by us: the `.emf` files are recorded with Windows GDI calls (`CreateEnhMetaFile`) from synthetic
drawings, the `.wmf` files (placeable, and `_nonplaceable`) are the same drawings recorded with `CreateMetaFile`, and the `_gdi_*.png` files are what Windows GDI `PlayEnhMetaFile` (`PlayMetaFile` for `_wmf_gdi_`) rendered for them into a white 32-bit bitmap of
the given size (the whole picture frame stretched over it). They contain no third-party content. `manifest.txt` and
`display.txt` record the machine they came from (Windows 11, 150% display scaling, ClearType on).
The renderer is compared with them by `WindowsReferenceTests`.
